items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Sam Hurd played trombone, and Wade Marcus played trombone.

ctx.x: But it was hearing you with Lloyd Price, who was in that band with the Lloyd Price band?

Well a guy named Arthur Horrell, he was a very popular trumpet player in around Gary, Indiana, in Chicago. A guy named, oh I've forgotten what his name is, but we called him Shaky. He was a trumpet player, we had three trumpets in the ring. We was a trumpet. And the saxophone section of the guy had a guy named Charles Reeves, and Ray Holloway, playing tenor, and Bean Bowl, I forgot Bean's first name, everybody called him Bean Bowl. He was playing baritone. And Chuck McClendon played tenor, saxophone. We had four…
And the last two I know were from New Orleans. Who else was from New Orleans in that band? Lester never played with the band. Excuse me? Lester didn't play with that band.
